cover.headline: No. 20 Florida beats Florida State 26-10 behind six sacks, two interceptions and four field goals
cover.dek: Florida's defense sacked Florida State six times, intercepted two passes and stopped the Seminoles on downs twice in the final five minutes. Patrick Durkin made all four of his field goals, and Jadan Baugh went over 1,000 rushing yards for the season.
